textRuns.value: Insight 1: Three one-time, high-value segments (New / At risk / Lost - high value) are 38.3% of customers but 72.5% of revenue - the first target for second-purchase and win-back campaigns.

Insight 2: 'At risk - high value' has the highest late-delivery rate (10.1% vs. 6.8% overall). Late delivery is strongly associated with worse reviews, so on-time delivery is a retention lever (association, not proven causation).

Insight 3: Only Champions + Loyal (2,015 customers, 2.2%) truly returned, bringing 4.1% of revenue. K-Means confirms recency and spend as the main dimensions, but finds no natural separate groups, so the rule-based segments are used for action.
